title: Hallux Valgus Correction (Bunionectomy)
description: Medicare coverage criteria for surgical correction of hallux valgus (bunionectomy with osteotomy). Requires documented severe pain interfering with ambulation, weight-bearing hallux valgus angle > 15 degrees or 1st-2nd intermetatarsal angle > 9 degrees, and failure of conservative management (shoe modification, orthotics).

criteria.name: Hallux Valgus Angle (> 15 Degrees on Weight-Bearing Radiographs)
criteria.description: Weight-bearing radiograph confirming hallux valgus angle (HVA) > 15 degrees or intermetatarsal angle (IMA) > 9 degrees.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Conservative Footwear and Orthotic Trial Failure (>= 3 Months)
criteria.description: Documented trial and failure of >= 3 months of conservative care including wide-toe-box shoes, orthotics, toe spacers, or padding.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Asymptomatic Cosmetic Bunionectomy Exclusion
criteria.description: Bunionectomy performed purely for cosmetic contouring in the absence of disabling pain or functional limitation in footwear.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

cms_reference.notes: No active NCD or LCD exists in MCD. Previously cited L34195 was Mohs Micrographic Surgery. Covered under podiatric surgical benefit.
cms_reference.authority: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A)
